header: The years the studio changed shape
subheadline: Three moments took Atlas Studio from two desks to three cities and a research tool of its own. The years between were client work.

milestones.title: The Berlin studio opens
milestones.description: Six designers moved to a shared floor on Oranienstraße, a short walk from the Kestrel Bank product teams.

milestones.title: Fieldnote raises EUR 2.1 million
milestones.description: We built a research repository for our own field studies. In September it became a separate company, with eight paying studios already using it.

milestones.title: The fortieth product ships
milestones.description: The Vireo Health patient portal went live in 11 countries. It was the studio's 40th product since 2016.
